meta.name: provenance
meta.description: 收集系统全链路操作日志，生成可追溯的执行证据链与向量索引，是多智能体系统可观测性与安全审计的底座。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪系统的每一步操作，留作可审计的证据链
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在维护多智能体系统，需要完整操作日志做安全审计
copy.tagline_en: Trace every operation across your system to build an auditable evidence chain
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a multi-agent system and need full operation logs for security audit

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会记录每一次分发、扫描、解析与卡片生成事件，按 trace_id 串成可追溯的证据链，并生成用于语义检索的向量索引条目，同时提供按条件检索历史证据的接口。
howto.when: 各官署在关键操作节点调用、或通过事件总线异步推送时写入证据链；需要审计或回滚定位时，可按 trace_id、时间窗、官署等维度检索。

say.text: 记录这次分发事件，actor 写军机处
say.note: 按 trace_id 写入证据链

say.text: 按 trace_id 检索这条链上的所有事件
say.note: 返回该 trace 的完整证据链

say.text: 查一下最近一小时各官署的操作记录
say.note: 按时间窗检索历史证据

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude logs every dispatch, scan, parse and card-generation event, links them into a traceable evidence chain by trace_id, builds vector index entries, and exposes a conditional retrieval interface.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an agency calls it at a key operation step or pushes events asynchronously over the event bus; also when you query by trace_id, time window or agency for audit and rollback.

say_en.text: Log this dispatch event, actor is the Grand Council
say_en.note: Writes into the evidence chain by trace_id

say_en.text: Retrieve all events on this trace_id
say_en.note: Returns the full evidence chain for that trace

say_en.text: Show all agency operations in the last hour
